The little guide to a lovely cake enquiry

Celebration notes · Studio journal

Illustrative design imagery

Start with the date

Your celebration date is the most useful place to begin. Include it in your first message, even if you have not decided on a design. Availability needs to be confirmed before the finer details are agreed.

Have a rough guest count

Knowing how many people you expect to serve helps shape the conversation about cake size or cupcake quantities. An estimate is a helpful starting point; the final serving requirements can be discussed together.

Share what you love

You do not need a complete design. A colour palette, a favourite flower, or a few inspiration images can be enough to explain your direction. Include any words, names or details that matter to your celebration.

Include the practical details

  • The date and type of occasion.
  • Your estimated guest count and budget.
  • Your preferred colours and flavours.
  • Any allergies or dietary requirements.
  • Your collection or delivery needs.

The contact page brings these details together into a message you can send to Adeela on Instagram. A message begins the conversation; it does not confirm a booking.
